# firebase_dart_sdk: Cloud Firestore for pure Dart

> An unofficial pure-Dart Cloud Firestore client, ported from the Firebase Android SDK, for Dart
> servers, command line tools, Flutter apps and the web (supported in Chrome). The core packages
> on pub.dev: `cloud_firestore_dart` 0.3.0 (the client), `firebase_app_dart` 0.2.0 (the
> `FirebaseApp`) and `firebase_auth_providers_dart` 0.3.0 (token providers); the repository README
> lists the others (the SQLite cache, the FlutterFire platform and admin packages). It is not FlutterFire's
> `cloud_firestore` and not the Firebase JS SDK: there is no `firebase_core`, no
> `Firebase.initializeApp()` and no platform channel, and many names differ.

Before writing code against these packages, read the guide for AI coding agents: it has the
imports, minimal programs, a table of FlutterFire and JS names with their names here, and the
rules (one instance per app and database, settings only at creation, writes complete on server
acknowledgement, `terminate()` on exit, memory cache unless you pass a SQLite opener). The exact
public API of the main library is the golden listing linked below.

## Start here

- [For AI coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/for_ai_agents.md): packages, imports, minimal programs, FlutterFire and JS names mapped to this client, rules, emulator testing
- [Public API listing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/test/unit/api/public_api.golden.txt): every public class and signature of `package:cloud_firestore_dart/cloud_firestore_dart.dart`, kept in sync with the code by a test
- [Repository README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/README.md): what the client does, its status, the packages
- [Coming from FlutterFire](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/migrating_from_flutterfire.md): when to use this client instead of `cloud_firestore`, setup differences, the API side by side
- [Features and limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/features.md): what is done, what is not, known gaps
- [Migrating from 0.1 to 0.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/api_migration_0_2.md): every renamed, reshaped, removed and added member, with its FlutterFire equivalent

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/getting_started.md): install, create the app and the instance, first read and write on the VM, in Flutter and on the web
- [Configuring the FirebaseApp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/firebase_app.md): options, application ids for desktop and servers, platform dependencies
- [Queries, data and the API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/queries_and_data.md): aggregations, OR queries, vector search, converters, bundles, snapshot JSON
- [Transactions and the lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/transactions_and_lifecycle.md): retries, read-only transactions, what `terminate()` does to work in progress
- [Offline persistence and cache settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/offline_persistence.md): memory and SQLite caches, the web cache, cache indexes, connectivity
- [Several clients on one cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/multiple_clients.md): hot restart, background isolates, second processes
- [Authentication and App Check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/authentication.md): signed-in users over REST, service accounts, Application Default Credentials, the Auth emulator
- [The emulator and testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/emulator_and_testing.md): connecting to the emulator, mock users, tests with `package:test`, Enterprise edition differences
- [Platforms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/platforms.md): the Dart VM on macOS, Linux and Windows, Flutter, the web transport and its limits
- [Firestore Lite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/lite.md): the client without cache and listeners
- [Pipelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/pipelines.md): server-side pipelines, preview, Enterprise edition only
- [Parity with the Firebase JS SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/parity.md): every area compared with the JS SDK, with the known limitations
- [Migrating from the `_vm` packages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/migrating_from_vm_packages.md): from `cloud_firestore_vm` and `firebase_core_vm`

## Packages

- [cloud_firestore_dart README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/README.md): the Firestore client
- [firebase_app_dart README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/firebase_core/firebase_app_dart/README.md): `FirebaseApp` and `FirebaseOptions`
- [firebase_auth_providers_dart README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/firebase_auth/firebase_auth_providers_dart/README.md): Firebase Auth sign-in over REST, service accounts, Application Default Credentials
- [cloud_firestore_dart_sqlite README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart_sqlite/README.md): the SQLite offline cache (`sqliteOpener`) for the VM, Flutter and the browser
- [cloud_firestore_dart_platform README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart_platform/README.md): the official `cloud_firestore` API with `cloud_firestore_dart` underneath
- [cloud_firestore_dart_flutterfire README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart_flutterfire/README.md): the FlutterFire app options and `firebase_auth` user for `cloud_firestore_dart`
- [firebase_admin_dart README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/firebase_admin/firebase_admin_dart/README.md): admin calls for trusted code (`auth.dart`: custom tokens, users, claims, revocation, `verifyIdToken`)

## Examples

- [Example index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/README.md): one short runnable program per topic, all against the emulator
- [main.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/main.dart): quick start with set, add, get, a query, a listener, a batch, a transaction and a count
- [common.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/common.dart): the `FirebaseApp` and emulator settings the examples share
- [server.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/server.dart): a backend process with one shared instance, server reads, a batch and a transaction
- [queries.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/queries.dart): filters, `Filter.or` and `Filter.and`, ordering, limits, cursors
- [crud_and_listeners.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/crud_and_listeners.dart): set, add, update, delete, field transforms, listeners
- [converters.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/converters.dart): typed data with `withConverter`
- [transactions_and_batches.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/transactions_and_batches.dart): batches, read-write and read-only transactions
- [offline_persistence.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/offline_persistence.dart): a SQLite cache on disk, offline reads and writes
- [cloud_firestore_dart_sqlite example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart_sqlite/example/main.dart): a SQLite cache on disk, written, reopened and read offline
- [lifecycle.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore_dart/example/lifecycle.dart): log level, `waitForPendingWrites`, `terminate`, `clearPersistence`
- [Example apps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/examples/README.md): a `shelf` HTTP server, a command line tool and a Cloud Run job, each a complete package
- [firestore_from_env.dart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/examples/cli/lib/firestore_from_env.dart): one instance from the environment, the emulator or Application Default Credentials

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/AGENTS.md): for agents that work inside this repository: layout, checks, rules

- [Performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/performance.md): what costs time and memory, and how to measure it
- [Long offline use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/long_offline.md): what a queue of millions of pending writes costs, and the settings that keep it small
- [Servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/long1eu/firebase_dart_sdk/main/docs/guides/server.md): the client in a backend process
